anomalies.message: CPU load average is significantly high across all intervals (1, 5, 15 minutes), indicating potential overutilization or a bottleneck.
No recent learning cycles or AI adjustments have been made, suggesting the AI system may not be functioning as expected.
Trading metrics show no active trades or opportunities generated, which might indicate a malfunction or misconfiguration in trading strategies.

optimizations.recommendation: Investigate and optimize CPU-intensive processes to reduce load and improve system performance.
Review and potentially update AI models or algorithms to ensure they are learning and adapting as expected.
Evaluate the performance and configuration of active trading strategies to ensure they are functioning correctly and generating opportunities.

recommendations.action: Conduct an immediate investigation into the high CPU load to identify and resolve the root cause.
recommendations.rationale: High CPU load can lead to system instability and degraded performance, affecting the platform's reliability.

recommendations.action: Perform a diagnostic check on the AI system to ensure it is operational and capable of generating learning cycles and adjustments.
recommendations.rationale: AI inactivity can lead to missed trading opportunities and suboptimal strategy performance.

recommendations.action: Audit the trading strategies to ensure they are correctly configured and capable of executing trades.
recommendations.rationale: Inactive trading can result in lost revenue and reduced platform effectiveness.
